dialogues.speaker: Babak
dialogues.text: This is the largest imported goods shop in Port Ormos. It is under the direct management of the Akademiya.

dialogues.speaker: Babak
dialogues.text: I am a researcher, and the shop manager.

dialogues.speaker: Babak
dialogues.text: There are a lot of tax exemptions due to official guarantees. So please be assured that these foreign goods are reasonably priced.

dialogues.speaker: Babak
dialogues.text: It also discourages smuggling in some way.
